theme: An open day with one real decision waiting on you.
greeting: The calendar is clear both today and tomorrow, Dan — no meetings either side. The pull today is a Valoris reply you promised and a holiday trip that's overdue to book.

needsAttention.title: Valoris is waiting on your read
needsAttention.detail: Martin at Valoris Catalysts sent their comments on your partnership proposal plus a draft confidentiality and non-compete agreement, and offered a call. You told him Nov 4 you'd come back to him and haven't yet.

needsAttention.title: December trip still unbooked
needsAttention.detail: The Dec 13–Jan 2 trip for all six is undecided; your own decide-by (Sep 30) and book-by (Oct 15) dates have passed, and holiday inventory is the thinnest of the year. Passports are now in hand.

needsAttention.title: Term-life quotes for Mike
needsAttention.detail: On the Mike + Dan board since Sep 25 — three quotes, term length and coverage. Four kids and still no policy in place.

flagged.title: Audible account merge
flagged.detail: Merge your accounts by Jan 12 to keep listening — plenty of runway.

inbox.noise: Everything else is promotions and newsletters — Hilton, Chairish, Teddy Stratford, Puzzmo, a Care.com survey.

recipe.title: Onion Tart
recipe.why: Autumn's cured storing onions cook down sweet and silky under a long, slow hand.

tasks.title: Order Portland king bedframe + outdoor shower soap holder

acts.line: A clear calendar both days — the kind of open stretch that doesn't come often.
One meaningful thread is sitting with you rather than with anyone else.
The girls are with Jen this stretch, so the house stays quiet and the clock is yours.
